critical.issue: Only dispatches send_wallet_receipt_email — does NOT also dispatch send_order_receipt_email. Per iter-10 fix scope: 'POST /api/me/orders/{id}/pay-with-wallet now dispatches BOTH send_wallet_receipt_email AND send_order_receipt_email after a successful debit.' Currently /app/backend/server.py:4530-4535 fires only notify_order_status + send_wallet_receipt_email. Customer paying-from-wallet therefore receives a wallet-debit receipt but no service-order receipt with VERIFIED/OPEN LIVE TRACKER block.

critical_code_review_comments: BUG — me_pay_with_wallet at server.py:4530-4535 misses send_order_receipt_email. The doc-string says 'Sends order-paid email + Telegram alert' but only sends notify_order_status (status update email) + send_wallet_receipt_email (wallet receipt). The new printable order receipt with OPEN LIVE TRACKER button never goes out for wallet payments — only for Cashfree (_cashfree_reconcile) and manual (PATCH /orders).

GOOD — _cashfree_reconcile correctly branches: wallet_topup → wallet receipt + notify_wallet_credited; service_payment → order receipt + notify_order_status. Both fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task.

GOOD — notify_quote_sent now lists 'Instant — Card / UPI / Netbanking (Cashfree, secured)' as the first payment option and the CTA button is 'PAY NOW · OPEN CASE' pointing to /track?id={case_id}&pay=1. The frontend then auto-scrolls + flashes the payment box (verified visually).

GOOD — PaymentBox component is well-structured: cf.configured drives the default tab; amount<=0 disables the Cashfree button with a clean 'AWAITING QUOTE' label; manual + crypto panes remain isolated.

MINOR — PaymentBox.payWithCashfree (line 59-69) doesn't disable the button via aria-disabled during the async POST; only the `disabled` HTML attribute is used. Double-click race is mitigated but `paying` state could be exposed via aria-busy.
